# MaalsoorHub

> Somalia's smart marketplace. Search trusted businesses, real estate, travel, health, and services. Connect directly via WhatsApp.

## Pages

- [Home](/home): Browse categories, featured listings, and verified businesses.
- [Explore](/explore): All service categories in one place.
- [Real Estate](/real-estate): Buy or rent houses, apartments, villas, land, and commercial property.
- [Travel](/travel): Flights, agencies, visas, Hajj & Umrah, tours, and car rental.
- [Hotels](/hotels): Find and book hotels.
- [Health](/health): Browse hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies.
- [Messages](/messages): Conversations with providers.
- [Profile](/profile): Account, saved listings, and settings.

## Optional

- [Post a listing](/post): Create a new listing.
